mgmt_bio.text: Delano Valentim de Andrade has been chief executive officer of BB Seguridade Participacoes since August 2025, elected by the board of directors on August 12 for the 2025-2027 term, with his inauguration set for August 20. A career Banco do Brasil employee of 40 years, he was CEO of BB Americas, the bank's US arm, from 2023 until August 2025. He holds a bachelor's degree in business administration with a specialization in foreign trade, an MBA in strategic leadership and a certificate in project management. He sits on BB Seguridade's board of directors as well, having succeeded Andre Gustavo Borba Assumpcao Haui.

sentences.quote: the company's capital-light structure, which outsources most underwriting risk to its operating subsidiaries, allows it to sustain high payout ratios without jeopardising regulatory solvency buffers
sentences.text: BB Seguridade, the insurance, pension and premium bond holding of Banco do Brasil, runs a capital-light model that outsources most underwriting risk to its operating subsidiaries, allowing it to sustain high payout ratios without straining solvency buffers.
Its equity story is anchored in a shareholder-remuneration policy distributing at least 70 percent of annual net profit, with 3.9 billion reais paid in dividends, an 88 percent payout ratio.
Pensions arm Brasilprev is the growth engine, with reserves at a record 496.5 billion reais after growth of more than 10 percent in 12 months.
Brazil's high interest rates lift financial results, as net investment income after taxes climbed 16 percent in the first half of 2026.
Earnings have proved resilient, with recurring net managerial income of 4.4 billion reais in H1 2026, up 3.2 percent, though crop insurance remains the main weak spot.
